sentence_list.content: Thirteen countries and territories have confirmed their participation in the Games.
Each Pacific Games association is allowed to enter a maximum of eight athletes, with no more than five of the same gender.
The tennis competition at the 2023 Pacific Games took place from 17 to 30 November 2023 at the National Tennis Center in Honiara, Solomon Islands.
Tennis is one of four sports on the 2023 Pacific Games programme that is scheduled to begin two days prior to the official opening of the Games.
